content: Mɨti'itiya meta mɨkati'itiya
Merikɨtsɨ 'ana Ketsutsi hetsɨa mekaniu'axɨani paritseutsixi meta 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitametetɨkai, Kerutsareme memeyekɨnekai, mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya:
—¿Titayari 'ahetsɨa miemete teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete yamekatekahu yututsima wayeiyaritsie? Mepɨka'ukamaimawa kepauka memɨte'utikwa'a.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —¿Titayarita xeme yaxekateyurie Kakaɨyari kemɨti'aita, yuyeiyaritsie xetewiyatɨ?
Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ katiniuta'aita: “Yaketinekamieni kememaitɨka 'apaapa meta 'amaama”, metatsiere: “Kemɨ'ane 'axamutaineni yupaapa meta yumaama wahepaɨtsita, ke'umierieni”.
Xemeta, 'apɨta, mɨpaɨ xekateni'ɨkitani kename xewitɨ yɨwe mɨpaɨ mɨtitahɨawe yupaapa yatɨni yumaama: “Nepɨkayɨwe nemɨmatsi'uparewieni, naime nemɨrexeiya Kakaɨyari nemɨtiyetuirikɨri”.
Merikɨte kemɨ'ane mɨpaɨ mɨtayɨni, waɨriyarika pɨkapitɨarieri yupapama muwaparewienikɨ. Mɨpaɨ yuyeiyari xete'uweiyatɨ tixaɨtɨ katihɨkɨtɨme xepayeitɨa Kakaɨyari niukieya.
Xemɨte'itawamete. Kitsariyaxi 'aixɨa putayɨ tihekɨatatɨ xehepaɨtsita, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ:

content.text: tita memɨte'ɨkita teɨteri wa'aitsika xeikɨa pɨhɨkɨ”».

content: Merikɨtsɨ Ketsutsi yu'aurie waruta'inieka teɨteri, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xekeneu'enana meta xeketenemaiwaweni.
Tita ka'itiyakame tewi mɨrayeitɨwa, tetana mɨranukayeikakɨ mɨkɨkɨ 'axapɨka'itɨarieni. Matsi tita tetana mɨratineikakɨ, mɨkɨkɨ pɨta ka'itiyatɨ payeika.
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete 'ahurawa me'ukɨneka mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —¿Mɨpaɨ petimate, paritseutsixi 'aniuki me'u'enieka mɨkawarunakixɨ?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Naitɨ 'iteɨri ne'ukiyari taheima makawe mɨka'ika'e pɨwatihunaxɨani.
Xekeniwahayewani, me'akɨkɨpetɨ mepɨwarahapana hipame. 'Akɨpetɨ xeime makɨpe xɨka hehana, yuhutatɨ mewatixawatsie meneukaxɨriekuni.
Hikɨ Pekuru mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ketaneutahekɨatsitɨiya 'ikɨ 'ɨkitsika.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Kari xemeta 'atsixepɨkatemate.
Tamɨ tita teta mɨranukayeika yuriepa nikayuyuipikeni, 'ariketa kanihɨamɨkɨ.
Peru tita teta mɨrayeneika 'iyaritsie patineika, mɨkɨkɨ tewi 'axakani'itɨarieka.

Karikɨ 'iyaritsie katinatineikani 'axa'iyaritɨarika, xeime kemɨtiumieni, xeime kemɨtiukumayɨani kayɨ'ɨya kayɨkɨna, kememɨteyukumaɨwa teɨteri kemɨkatiheitserie, 'inawari, 'itarika meta 'axaniuki hipame wahepaɨtsita.
'Ikɨ katinihɨkɨtɨni tewi ka'itiyakame memayeitɨwa, xɨka tiukwani kamaimatɨ mɨkɨkɨ tewi ka'itiyatɨ pɨkahayeika.
Yuri kemɨti'eriekai 'uka Kanani kiekame
Merikɨtsɨ mana mɨyetɨa Ketsutsi, kaneyani Tiru kwieyaritsie meta Tsiruni.

Hikɨ mana 'uka Kanani kiekame, mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie heyeyaka, hepana kaniuyani mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —Kenenenenimayaka, Ti'aitame, Rawiri pemɨnu'aya. Neniwe 'uka waɨkawamekɨ pɨtiuka'eniwa, kakaɨyari 'axamɨ'ane 'inɨkaku.
Peru Ketsutsi pɨka'ita'ei. Hikɨ 'ahurawa me'akɨneka teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete, mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Kenanunɨ'a, pɨtatsi'uweiya xeikɨa 'utahiwatɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ne Kakaɨyari muxatsimama memeuyexɨri wahetsɨa xeikɨa nekaneyenɨ'arieni, 'ixaheritsixi teɨteriyari wahetsɨa.
'Uka 'ahurawa 'ayaka kaniutihɨximakeni hɨxiena, hikɨ mɨpaɨ katinitawawirieni: —Ti'aitame 'aku, keneneuparewi.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —'Aixɨa pɨka'ane xɨka yuniwema paa warunawairieni, tsɨikɨri pɨta xɨka warumini.
'Uka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Yuri peputaine Ti'aitame, peru 'atsita tsɨikɨri temɨxikiyari mepukukwa'a wakutsiyarima wamexatsie manakawiwike.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —'Uka 'aku, waɨkawa yuri pepɨti'erie. Yakereyɨni tita pemɨra'iwawa. Hikɨ 'ana kwitɨwa 'aixɨa reu'erietɨ kanayani nu'aya.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiwarumi nauka miriyari
Merikɨte Ketsutsi mana kaniyeyani, hikɨ Karereya harakunayari tetsita paitɨ kaninuani. Mana yemuritsie kanitiyune mana kanayerɨni.

Hikɨ hetsɨana mekaniu'axɨani yumɨiretɨ teɨteri, mekaniwa'atɨani memɨ'ɨkatetutuni, memɨkaheuneniere, memɨwaritutuni, memɨkaniuwawe meta hipame tekwikwikate, hɨxiena mekaniwa'atɨani, mɨkɨta 'aixɨa meteheu'eriekame kaniwarayeitɨani.

Hikɨ teɨteri mekanihɨxiyakaitɨni mewaxeiyatɨ memɨkaniuwawekai me'utiniukame, memɨwaritutunikai 'aixɨa me'aneneme, memɨ'ɨkatutunikai meku'uwame, meta memɨkaheunenierekai meheuneniereme mewaxeiyatɨ. 'Aixɨa mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni 'ixaheritsixi yukakaɨyari hepaɨtsita.

Hikɨ Ketsutsi yu'aurie waruta'inieka yuhetsɨa miemete teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Ne 'ikɨ teɨteri nepɨwareunenimaya, haika tukari mekaniyuriekari nehetsɨa meta 'ikwai mepɨkahexeiya. Nepɨkanewaɨriya mekatekwakame nemɨwarutateutɨani, kapa mehetiweranaxɨame mehekaxɨrieni huyeta.
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: —¿'Ena makumawetsie hakewa tepeikaxeiya paa mɨyapaɨmeme temɨtewaminikɨ teɨteri mɨyameyupaɨmeme?
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya: —¿Kepaɨmeme paa xepexeiya? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —'Atahutame, meta tsapari yayupaɨmeme 'etsimepepeme.
Hikɨ katiniuta'aita teɨteri 'amemukuyaxixɨanikɨ kwiepa.
Paa 'atahutame 'anu'ɨka meta tsapari, pamɨpariyutsi Kakaɨyari kaniupitɨani, hikɨ kanititara paa meta kaniwayetuirieni teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete. Mɨkɨta teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete teɨteri mekaniwaruta'ɨitɨani.
Yunaitɨ mekateniukwani yemekɨ mekaniutihuxani. 'Arike teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mekanikuxeɨrieni tarimeyari muyuhayewaxɨ, 'atahuta tsikɨiwitiyari hɨpɨnetɨ patɨa.
Memɨte'ukwai 'ukitsi nauka miriyari mekaniyupaɨmekaitɨni, 'ukari meta tɨɨri meka'inɨaritɨ.
Hikɨ warutateutɨaka teɨteri, kanuwatsie kanikayerɨni, Makarani kwieyaritsie kaneyani.
